seo.title: Port Moresby homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Port Moresby.

page.heading: PORT MORESBY - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: Port Moresby Police 180 0100. Family and sexual violence helpline: 7150 8000. Safe transport for women at risk: 7222 1234.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Port Moresby does not have a single public homelessness intake line. City Mission provides residential programmes for specific groups, while survivors of violence can contact the 1-Tok helpline, Femili PNG or the Meri Seif Line for case management, safe transport and accommodation referrals.
page.footer: Main sources: City Mission PNG, National Capital District Provincial Health Authority, Port Moresby General Hospital, ChildFund PNG 1-Tok helpline, Femili PNG, Micronesian Legal Services and the listed services.

entries.title: 1-Tok Kaunselin Helpim Lain
entries.description: Free nationwide counselling, information and referrals for family and sexual violence. The helpline can connect callers with case managers, health care, police and safe accommodation.
entries.how_to_access: Call from anywhere in Papua New Guinea.

entries.title: Meri Seif Line
entries.description: Safe transport for women at risk in the National Capital District.
entries.address: Port Moresby and the National Capital District
entries.hours: Call when safe transport is needed
entries.how_to_access: Call the line and explain your location and immediate safety needs.

entries.title: City Mission New Life Skills Training Centre
entries.description: Residential rehabilitation and skills programme for young men. It is not a general walk-in night shelter and admission depends on City Mission assessment.
entries.how_to_access: Use the City Mission contact page and ask about the Port Moresby programme, eligibility and current space.

entries.title: Haus Ruth
entries.description: City Mission long-term shelter for survivors of gender-based violence. The location is not published for safety.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the 1-Tok helpline, Femili PNG or City Mission. Do not attempt to locate a confidential shelter directly.

entries.title: City Mission PNG - Koki
entries.description: City Mission's Port Moresby administration and transition dorm for young men who have completed its residential programme. Staff can explain current programmes and referrals.
entries.how_to_access: Use the organisation's contact page and ask for the Port Moresby office.

entries.title: Port Moresby General Hospital
entries.description: Main public referral hospital in Port Moresby. The Family Support Centre assists survivors of violence and can provide medical care and social-work referrals.
entries.how_to_access: For violence-related care, ask for the Family Support Centre or a social worker. Emergency care comes first.

entries.title: NCD public health clinics
entries.description: Public clinics across the National Capital District provide primary care and can refer people to gender-based-violence, disability and hospital services. The official list includes Gerehu, Tokarara, Six Mile, Kaugere and other clinics.
entries.how_to_access: Use the official clinic list and attend the nearest open facility.

entries.title: City Mission skills training
entries.description: Residential life-skills and vocational training for eligible young men through the New Life Skills Training Centre.
entries.how_to_access: Contact City Mission to ask about eligibility, residential intake and the next programme.

entries.title: Public Solicitor's Office
entries.description: Government legal assistance for eligible people, including criminal and some civil matters. Capacity and eligibility rules apply.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the Department of Justice and ask for the Public Solicitor's Office intake process.

entries.title: Femili PNG Port Moresby
entries.description: Case management for survivors of family, sexual and sorcery-accusation-related violence. Staff can help find safe accommodation, contact police and access medical and legal support.
entries.how_to_access: Call the Port Moresby number. Use the 1-Tok helpline outside office hours.

entries.title: Family Support Centre - Port Moresby General Hospital
entries.description: Medical and psychosocial help for survivors of family and sexual violence. The service can provide information and referrals to counselling, police, legal aid and protection services.
entries.how_to_access: Attend the hospital and ask for the Family Support Centre. Emergency treatment does not require money according to the published referral guidance.
